name: KU Leuven
summary: Flemish research university in Leuven; seven English-taught bachelor's in Leuven and Brussels, two of them joint European degrees.

ib.text: The IB Diploma gives access; no points minimum is published. It exempts you from an English test for most programmes if at least half your courses were in English. No 2027 deadlines yet.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Business Administration
programmes.about: Management, economics, entrepreneurship, quantitative methods and law taught in English in Brussels, with business games, a business project, an optional internship and optional Dutch, French, Spanish or German.
programmes.ib: Every applicant takes the faculty's free online maths test and uploads the result.
programmes.selectionNote: Every applicant takes the faculty's free online maths test and uploads the result; the faculty then decides on your complete file.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Business Engineering
programmes.about: Finance, accounting, marketing, logistics and HR built on strong maths, statistics, data analysis and modelling; a joint degree where you take courses and exams at both KU Leuven and UCLouvain Saint-Louis in central Brussels.
programmes.ib: Joint degree with UCLouvain Saint-Louis. Maths AA HL strongly advised; every applicant takes the faculty's free online maths test.
programmes.selectionNote: Every applicant takes the faculty's free online maths test and uploads the result; admission is at the faculty's discretion on your complete file.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering Technology
programmes.about: A common core of maths, physics, chemistry and computational thinking at the Group T campus, then chemical, electromechanical or electronics-and-ICT engineering technology, learnt through projects that end in designing an embedded product.
programmes.ib: For 2027-28: the OMPT-G maths and science test at 60%, or with an IB the starting test in Leuven in early July (compulsory, not binding). SAT and ACT are no longer listed.
programmes.selectionNote: With an IB you can skip the OMPT-G test by sitting KU Leuven's starting test in Leuven in early July: taking it is compulsory, but the result does not decide admission.

programmes.name: Bachelor of European Studies
programmes.about: Europe and the EU studied through politics, law, economics, history and philosophy in one joint Una Europa degree: you study at two or three of its partner universities and graduate with a single joint diploma.
programmes.ib: Una Europa joint degree across two or three universities; reading-and-writing assignment and a video pitch. English test required even with the IB.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published: a reading-and-writing assignment, a video pitch of up to 120 seconds and your documents. Applications reopen in autumn 2026.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Philosophy
programmes.about: A broad historical and systematic training in philosophy, with logic, critical thinking and close reading, at the Institute of Philosophy, home to a major philosophy library and the Husserl Archives; you add a minor in liberal arts, education or theology.
programmes.ib: Reading and writing assignment, CV and motivation letter. English test (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90); the IB does not exempt you.
programmes.selectionNote: You read a short academic text and answer questions on it, and send a motivation letter and CV; admission rests on your academic potential. An English test is required.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Theology and Religious Studies
programmes.about: Christianity alongside other world religions: Bible studies, systematic theology, ethics and church history, plus biblical and modern languages, in an intercultural class at a faculty that can also award church degrees.
programmes.ib: Writing sample, motivation letter and CV; you may apply without an English test, and the faculty judges your English from the file.
programmes.selectionNote: A writing sample from your studies, a motivation letter and a CV; the committee judges your English from the file and may ask for a TOEFL or IELTS score.

programmes.name: Joint Bachelor in Sustainability
programmes.about: Sustainability studied across disciplines in an Una Europa joint degree of partner universities including KU Leuven: a first year together in Kraków, then study elsewhere in the alliance.
programmes.ib: Una Europa joint degree; you apply through Jagiellonian University in Kraków and sit a proctored online entrance exam. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published: apply on Jagiellonian University's IRK system and sit a proctored online entrance exam; you are admitted, waitlisted or not admitted.

notes: KU Leuven sets a deadline per programme in its application-window tool, which as of September 2026 offers no 2027-28 year; for 2026-27 the EEA deadlines ran from 1 April (European Studies) to 1 July (Business).
Almost all other KU Leuven bachelor's are taught in Dutch; for those, EEA applicants have no application deadline.
